summary.name: Cascads
summary.one_liner: Cascads is a multi-brand growth cockpit that turns sourced public signals into brand-specific posts and videos, then handles approval, scheduling, publishing and measurement in one workspace.
keywords: plain-english: schedule posts for several clients
plain-english: turn news into social posts
use_cases: Running social media for several brands or clients from one workspace
Turning public trend signals into on-brand social posts
Producing short videos, carousels and captions for multiple brands
Adding human approval before scheduled posts go live
Scheduling and publishing to connected social networks
Tracking post performance with authorised metrics
summary.what_it_does: Cascads takes a brand's website and an editable brief as its starting point, then creates concepts, posts, carousels, videos and captions in each brand's voice. Its Radar component gathers public signals from multiple sources and shows source, freshness, corroboration and brand fit before a user picks one to act on. Workspaces can require human approval before publication, and direct publishing is limited to networks and formats each account permits; other items become ready-to-post reminders. Each brand keeps its own accounts, voice, calendar and queue, while portfolio views give operators one place to see everything. The page also describes a calendar with smart slots, transcription and captioning for long videos, and a Public API v1 and Remote MCP.
notable: Multi-brand workspace with separate voice, calendar, accounts and queue per brand
Radar shows source and freshness for each public signal before action
Optional human approval gate before scheduling or publishing
Public API v1 and Remote MCP access on paid plans
caveats: Paid plans: Solo €41.30/month, Studio €104.30/month, Agency €279.30/month (yearly billing shown), with monthly credit limits
Direct publishing only where the network, account permission and format allow; other formats stay as manual reminders
Signals are research leads, not proof of virality or relevance
